Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to trash 3 cards in my hand even when my opponent has 2 or fewer Digimon?

Effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon, it performs any security checks it normally would.)

[When Digivolving] You may trash up to 3 cards in your hand. If you do, for each card trashed, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, for each suspended Digimon your opponent has in play, gain 1 memory.
